bullets.text: In Chennai, AI, IT and Digital Services Minister Kumar inaugurated completed project works worth Rs.1.08 crore in the Adyar zone, and the office should monitor community benefit.

In the Thiruvallur district Red Hills area, a school van driver was arrested under the POCSO Act for allegedly sexually harassing a 5-year-old girl and threatening her, and the office should track police follow-up.
In Chennai, sudden heavy rain caused waterlogging, and the meteorological department forecasts heavy rain in eight districts tomorrow, so the office should watch for disruptions.
In Velachery, heavy vehicle traffic congestion caused severe commuter delays during Diwali rush, and the office should monitor traffic management.
In Besant Nagar, a young couple visited at 2 AM to watch the sunrise and faced unexpected trouble, and the office should monitor local safety.
In Adambakkam, Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix the train-platform gap at the new station, and the office should track infrastructure safety.
In Chennai, the home secretary transferred four police officers including Pallikaranai Deputy Commissioner Eswaran, and the office should note the administrative changes.
In Thiruvallur, BSNL announced the upcoming launch of 4G services under phase IX.2 in Chennai and neighbouring districts including Thiruvallur, and the office should monitor rollout progress.
In Pallipattu within Thiruvallur district, police arrested three Andhra men and solved an 86.5 sovereign theft case from last October, and the office should track recovery updates.
In Ponneri, farmers filed a Chief Minister's special cell petition over paddy crop damage caused by substandard weedicide, and the office should watch for relief action.
In Tamil Nadu, Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay ordered a Rs.2,000 crore allocation for the Vetri Laptop Scheme for college students, and the office should monitor scheme implementation.
In Chennai, Vultr launched a 20-megawatt AI supercompute cluster powered by over 10,000 AMD GPUs, and the office should watch technology sector growth.
In Tamil Nadu political circles, Minister Rajmohan lashed out alleging the first AI scam was committed by DMK, and the office should monitor political reactions.
In Chennai, the supply of 1,800 dubious books at inflated prices to Periyar Arivulagam triggered a DMK-TVK blame game, and the office should watch developments.
